in_marathi.name: Basudha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Basudha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Basudha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘vasudha,’ which means ‘prosperity,’ ‘wealth,’ or ‘material world.’ According to Hindu mythology, Vasudha is the goddess of the earth and the source of all material riches. The name Basudha is a tribute to this divine goddess.
